correctness.rationale: Proved for all n by bijection between regressive monotone maps and ordered breadth-first plane forests: depth is forest height, rank counts fixed roots and nonroot internal vertices. Standard tree-sequence decomposition rigorously yields the exact bivariate recursion. The rank=d boundary requires a single spine with optional side leaves and has generating function x^{r+1}/(1-x)^{2r-1}, hence the claimed binomial. Replayed direct brute enumeration and independent integer polynomial arithmetic for all 6917 objects in n<=9, but finite checks are not infinite proof.

value.rationale: For a foundational infinite Catalan transformation family, simultaneous original image rank and eventual power stabilization are natural algebraic invariants; their joint correlation cannot be recovered from separate known rank and potency counts. The exact rational bivariate coefficient scheme covers every size/rank/depth and identifies sharp feasible upper frontier d=r with nontrivial exact binomial multiplicities, enabling structural enumeration without a preset finite cutoff. This is a complete natural invariant, not a small arbitrary parameter slice.
